task: Local worker-3 vmdk grew to 292G while the guest used 43G. Find the writer, cut its rewrite rate, record the lesson.

events.summary: Change only trivy-operator scannerReportTTL. Deliberately left alone: operator OOMKill, kubelet image GC, node disk shrink or rebuild, Harbor, other apps.

Guest used 43G vs host vmdk 292G; Prometheus 3d max guest usage ~47G on all nodes; node_disk_written 517GiB on worker-3 vs 53-128GiB elsewhere; top container_fs_writes writer is security-system scan-vulnerabilityreport pods.
scannerReportTTL 24h (chart default) to 168h so reports are not rescanned daily, each rescan re-downloading the Trivy DB to node disk.
make test run in the worktree; live effect to be confirmed via trivy-operator-config OPERATOR_SCANNER_REPORT_TTL.
Rewrite rate reduced; host space not reclaimed (needs disk rebuild, not approved).
